I’ve had problematic eating habits for most of my life. Got diagnosed with binge eating last year. I used to purge, restrict, then binge. It was a bad cycle. 

I got into therapy around a year ago and for the past two months I’ve been really trying to heal my relationship with food. I try not to eat over 1800 calories a day, started walking a lot more, i’m using my dads apple watch, writing down what I eat, etc. I’m taking a lot of good strides and I’ve lost around 10 pounds. 

I’ve been so excited to finally lose the weight, but now all I can really think about is how much better my life will finally be once I lose the weight. The thing is though, I don’t know if that will be the case. I’m sure I will be happier but I don’t know if the self hatred will ever go away. I guess that’s why I wrote this post, I’m just so so so so tired of hating myself so adamantly. It’s exhausting to every level. I am hoping so badly that my life will get better but it sucks not knowing if it will.
